Bingkun Qi · 亓炳堃互动教学示例 / 01

波的叠加

先预测，再观察，最后推导 · 10 分钟自学讲义

两列振幅都是 1 的波相遇，合振幅一定是 2 吗？用一个判断、一次观察和一段推导来检验。

模型约定：线性叠加；两列同频率、同波长、同向传播的简谐波，沿同一方向振动，相位差 φ 固定。A₁ = 1，A₂ 可调。位移与振幅使用相同的相对单位。

01 · 预测 2 分钟

先不看实验读数，填写预测值。两列波的波峰会在同一位置出现吗？

A₁A₂φ预测 R观察 / 计算 R
110°
1190°
11180°

我的理由：

02 · 观察 3 分钟

打开互动示例，将 A₂ 设为 1，依次调到 0°、90°、180°。暂停动画，在同一个横坐标读取两列波的位移，检查它们的代数和，再记录合振幅。

φ = 90° 时，在第一列波波峰处，合位移为 1。合成波的最大位移也只有 1 吗？

03 · 推导 3 分钟

令 θ = kx − ωt。先相加位移，再展开：

y = A₁ sin θ + A₂ sin(θ + φ)
y = (A₁ + A₂ cos φ) sin θ + A₂ sin φ cos θ = R sin(θ + δ)
R² = (A₁ + A₂ cos φ)² + (A₂ sin φ)²
R = √(A₁² + A₂² + 2A₁A₂ cos φ)

将 sin θ 和 cos θ 的系数与 R sin(θ + δ) 的展开式比较，再平方相加，消去 δ。

挑战 · 反相就一定完全抵消吗？ 2 分钟

A₁ = 1，A₂ = 0.50，φ = 180°。计算 R，再用滑块验证。若只改变 φ，R 的最小值与最大值是多少？

关键区别：叠加的是同一位置、同一时刻的带符号位移：y = y₁ + y₂。振幅是偏离平衡位置的最大距离；一般不能直接相加。
完成后核对：前三项依次为 2、√2 ≈ 1.41、0。90° 时合成波的峰值位置不同于任一原波峰值。挑战：R = |1 − 0.50| = 0.50；范围为 0.50 ≤ R ≤ 1.50。反相且等振幅才能完全抵消。

Bingkun Qi · 亓炳堃Teaching example / 01

Wave superposition

Predict, observe, then derive · A 10-minute self-study worksheet

Two waves each have an amplitude of 1. Must their resultant amplitude be 2? Test a prediction with a graph and a short derivation.

Model: Linear superposition of two sinusoidal waves with the same frequency, wavelength and direction of travel, vibrating along the same direction. Phase difference φ is fixed. A₁ = 1; A₂ varies. Displacements and amplitudes use the same relative units.

01 · Predict 2 min

Before looking at the readout, predict R. Will both crests occur at the same position?

A₁A₂φPredicted RObserved / calculated R
110°
1190°
11180°

My reasoning:

02 · Observe 3 min

Open the interactive lesson. Set A₂ to 1 and test 0°, 90° and 180°. Pause at each setting. Read both displacements at the same horizontal coordinate, check their algebraic sum, then record the resultant amplitude.

At φ = 90°, the resultant displacement is 1 at a crest of wave 1. Is that also the maximum displacement of the resultant?

03 · Derive 3 min

Let θ = kx − ωt. Add displacements and expand:

y = A₁ sin θ + A₂ sin(θ + φ)
y = (A₁ + A₂ cos φ) sin θ + A₂ sin φ cos θ = R sin(θ + δ)
R² = (A₁ + A₂ cos φ)² + (A₂ sin φ)²
R = √(A₁² + A₂² + 2A₁A₂ cos φ)

Match the coefficients of sin θ and cos θ with the expansion of R sin(θ + δ). Square and add to eliminate δ.

Challenge · Do opposite phases always cancel? 2 min

Set A₁ = 1, A₂ = 0.50 and φ = 180°. Calculate R, then test it. What are the minimum and maximum R when only φ changes?

Keep this distinction: Superposition adds signed displacements at the same position and time: y = y₁ + y₂. Amplitude is the maximum distance from equilibrium; amplitudes do not generally add.
Check after completing: The first three answers are 2, √2 ≈ 1.41, and 0. At 90°, the resultant peaks at a different position from either wave. Challenge: R = |1 − 0.50| = 0.50; its range is 0.50 ≤ R ≤ 1.50. Complete cancellation requires opposite phases and equal amplitudes.
